column4: All new models migrate. Foreign key relations verified. No breaking changes to base schema.
column12: Tier 1–5 premium features all depend on these models.

column3: Create seed script for default project statuses, priorities, sample projects, and OKR objectives.
column4: Running prisma db seed populates all lookup tables. Sample data usable in dev/staging.

column3: Create /projects/attachments/ folder in S3. Update IAM policies to allow backend write access. Block public access.
column4: Backend can write to new folder. Public access blocked and verified. File type validation enforced at IAM level.

column3: Configure email service integration with VF-LEG-001 shared notification service. Document API contract. Implement test harness.
column4: Test email sends successfully from backend. Contract with shared service documented and signed off.
column12: Dependency contract with VF-LEG-001 must be agreed in Sprint 0 before this ticket is started.

column3: Document the interface between PPM and the shared User Model from VF-LEG-001. Define which fields PPM extends, which role enum values are shared, and how JWT claims are structured.
column4: Written contract signed off by CLM and PPM leads. Prisma schema reflects agreed shared fields. No duplication of user data.
column12: Sprint 0 pre-requisite. Blocks all RBAC implementation.

column3: Create REST endpoints to create, read, update, and archive projects. Owner assignment enforced on creation. Baseline snapshot created on project approval.
column4: POST/GET/PATCH endpoints work. Owner assignment enforced. Baseline snapshot written to ProjectBaseline on status change to APPROVED.

column3: Implement auto-calculation of Project.ragStatus based on task overdue counts, RAID priorities, and budget variance. Priority order: RED > AMBER > GREEN. Initial state GREEN. Auto-revert on resolution.
column4: All edge cases in §2.1.3 pass. Priority order correct. Initial state GREEN on project creation. Auto-revert verified. Manual override requires Admin + audit log entry.
column12: Trigger: task status change, task due date pass, RAID item creation/update, budget variance change.

column3: Implement full 5-state task transition machine: TODO, IN_PROGRESS, IN_REVIEW, BLOCKED, DONE. Enforce valid transitions per matrix. Allow backward transitions per matrix. Validate blockers before DONE.
column4: All 5 states implemented. Invalid transitions rejected (HTTP 422). Backwards transitions allowed per matrix. Blocker check prevents DONE when blockers active. PM/Admin required to reopen DONE.
column12: State machine matrix defined in §2.2.4 of spec.

column3: Implement CRUD for Risks, Actions, Issues, and Decisions. Decision register fields (optionsConsidered, rationale, approvedById) included. Priority sorting. Link RAID items to timeline date for Gantt flag rendering.
column4: All four RAID types work. Decision register fields stored and returned. Priority sorting works. loggedDate stored for Gantt flag positioning.

column3: Implement allocated vs spent tracking. Calculate variance %. Trigger AMBER alert at 5–10% variance. Trigger RED alert and RAG recalculation at >10% variance. Require receipt upload above configurable threshold.
column4: Variance calculated correctly. AMBER/RED thresholds trigger alerts and RAG recalculation. Receipt requirement enforced above threshold. All budget changes audit logged.

column3: Implement endpoints to add/remove team members to projects. Store allocation %. Compute overallocation flag when user's total allocation across projects exceeds 100%.
column4: Users linked to projects. Allocation % stored. Overallocation flag computed and exposed in API response. Notification triggered on overallocation.

column3: Implement S3 upload logic for project files. Validate permitted file types and size limits. Store S3 URL in DB. Handle upload failures gracefully.
column4: Files upload to S3. URL stored in DB. Permitted types enforced (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PNG, JPG — max 25MB per file, 500MB per project). Upload failures return actionable error. S3 deletion on project archive.
column12: File type/size limits must be formally defined before development — see §2.2.5 of spec.

column3: Create NestJS interceptor to log all state-changing actions to ProjectAuditLog. Entries must be immutable (no UPDATE/DELETE endpoints exposed).
column4: Every state change creates an audit log entry with userId, action, previousValue, newValue, timestamp. No DELETE/PUT endpoints on AuditLog. Verified in QA-06.

column3: Create cached endpoint returning aggregate data for the dashboard: RAG heatmap counts, delivery gauge (% on time), budget overview (total allocated vs spent), OKR coverage %, utilisation summary.
column4: Returns all aggregate stats in a single call. Cache invalidation on project RAG change. Response time < 500ms P95 at 500 projects.

column3: Create endpoint returning all data needed for Gantt rendering: project bars (start/end dates), milestones, dependency edges, forecast zones (from ProjectForecast), RAID flags (from RAIDItem.loggedDate and priority), baseline ghost bars.
column4: All six Gantt signal types returned correctly. Filtered by user visibility. Response optimised for 100+ projects.
column12: Frontend Gantt (FE-04) depends on this endpoint shape being stable.

column3: Implement ProjectDependency CRUD (FTS, STS, FTF types). On date change, perform topological sort of dependency graph and cascade date changes to downstream dependents. Notify downstream project owners.
column4: Dependency CRUD works. Topological sort correctly identifies critical path. Date cascade triggers notifications. Circular dependency detected and rejected.
column12: Topological sort must be proven in isolated spike before integration. Scope BE-GANTT-SPIKE separately if needed.

column3: Calculate P50, P85, P95 delivery date estimates using N=10,000 simulations sampling from SprintRecord historical throughput distribution. Store in ProjectForecast. Nightly recalculation job. Suppress output if fewer than 3 sprints of data.
column4: P50/P85/P95 computed correctly against test dataset. Confidence indicator suppressed below data threshold. Nightly job runs without timeout. Results stored and returned by Gantt API.
column12: Requires SprintRecord data from at least 3 sprints. Display confidence indicator in UI. Do not expose forecast until minimum threshold met.

column3: Implement GateReview CRUD. Enforce required approvers list. Failed gate blocks downstream phase progression unless waived by Admin. All outcomes audit logged.
column4: Gate CRUD works. Required approvers enforced. Failure blocks progression (HTTP 403 on next-phase request). Waiver requires Admin role + reason. Audit log entry on every outcome.

column3: Aggregate weekly resource allocation per user across all projects. Expose capacity vs demand view. Flag overallocation above configurable threshold.
column4: Weekly allocation correctly aggregated. Overallocation threshold configurable per organisation. API response consumable by FE-12 capacity grid.

column3: Implement Objective and KeyResult CRUD. ProjectObjectiveLink model. OKR coverage calculation endpoint. Contribution score (0–100) per project-objective link.
column4: OKR CRUD works. Coverage % calculated correctly. Contribution scores stored and returned. Portfolio dashboard receives OKR data.

column3: Implement project export in PDF and CSV formats. Define fields included, formatting standards. Access control: PM and Stakeholders (own projects only).
column4: PDF export renders correctly with all defined fields. CSV export is parseable. File size limits enforced. Access control verified. Export time < 30s P95.
column12: Fields and formatting must be defined before development — see §2.2.5 of spec.

column3: Allow users to configure notification preferences: instant vs daily digest per notification type. PM can configure project-level alert thresholds.
column4: Preferences stored per user. Digest job batches instant notifications correctly. Project-level thresholds override system defaults.
column12: Addresses notification fatigue risk in §6.

column3: Build /ops/portfolio/dashboard with RAGHeatmap (grid of projects coloured by status), DeliveryGauge (% on-time), BudgetOverview (allocated vs spent), OKRCoverageRing, semantic filter pills.
column4: All five components render correctly. Filter pills (All, Engineering, PMO, At Risk) work. At Risk filter shows only Amber/Red. Data refreshes on project RAG change.

column3: Build /ops/projects/[id] with tabbed navigation: Kanban, RAID, Budget, Files, Gates, Decisions. ProjectHeader shows RAG status, owner, dates, health score, forecast date.
column4: Tabs switch content without full reload. Header shows all six data points. RAG status colour-coded. Forecast confidence indicator shown.

column3: Build drag-and-drop Kanban using @dnd-kit. Five columns matching state machine (TODO, IN_PROGRESS, IN_REVIEW, BLOCKED, DONE). Optimistic UI update. Blocker indicator on cards. WIP limit display.
column4: Tasks move between valid columns. Invalid transitions prevented with user-facing error. Blocker icon shown on BLOCKED cards. Optimistic update with rollback on failure.

column3: Build custom SVG Gantt with: bar rendering (coloured by RAG), progress fill layer (35% opacity), today line, milestone diamonds (pulse if overdue), RAID risk flags, dependency Bezier curves, baseline ghost bars, slip zones. Time scale toggle (Month/Quarter/Year). Semantic filter pills.
column4: All seven premium signal types render correctly. Today line positioned accurately. Milestone diamonds pulse when overdue. RAID flags show tooltip on hover. Slip zone appears when forecast > planned end. Baseline ghost bars visible behind current bars.
column12: Highest SP ticket in the project. This is the premium differentiator. Do NOT use a third-party Gantt library — custom SVG/Canvas only.

column3: Add drag handles to Gantt bars. On drag, call BE-11 topological sort. Cascade date changes to downstream bars with animation. Show constraint violation warning before confirm.
column4: Bar drag updates project dates. Downstream bars animate to new positions. Constraint violation modal shown before confirmation. Undo available for 30 seconds.
column12: Gate behind separate feature flag. BE-11 topological sort must be stable before this is started.

column3: Build table for RAID items with filters (Type: R/A/I/D, Priority, Status). Inline status editing. Decision register tab with full decision fields. RAID item creation modal.
column4: All four RAID types filterable. Inline status edit saves without full reload. Decision register shows all fields from DecisionRecord model. Creation modal validates all required fields.

column3: Build line/bar chart for Planned vs Actual spend. Variance % highlighted amber at 5–10%, red above 10%. Receipt upload link per spend entry. Budget history timeline.
column4: Chart renders with correct data. Variance thresholds colour-coded correctly. Receipt upload opens file picker linked to BE-07. Chart updates on spend entry.

column3: Build 5-step form: Details ? OKR Link ? Budget ? Team ? Gate Configuration. Each step validates before advance. Summary review before submit.
column4: All 5 steps validate inputs before advancing. OKR selector shows active objectives. Team member search works. Gate configuration optional but saves if provided. Summary step shows all inputs before final submit.

column3: Build modal opening from Kanban card. Shows task details, state transition buttons (per state machine), comments thread, file attachments, cycle time, assignee.
column4: Modal opens without page reload. State transition buttons show only valid next states. Comments save in real time. File attachment uploads via BE-07. Cycle time displayed.

column3: Implement route guards and component-level permission checks based on RBAC matrix in §2.2.3. All four roles tested: Admin, PM, Member, Stakeholder.

column3: Build drag-and-drop upload zone for project attachments. Show upload progress. Validate file type and size client-side. File list updates on success. Delete with confirmation.
column4: Drag-and-drop works. Upload progress shown. Client-side type/size validation matches server-side rules. File list reflects upload result. Delete requires confirmation.

column3: Build weekly grid showing each person's allocated % vs available hours across all their projects. Overallocation (>100%) highlighted red. Skill badges per person. Filterable by team.
column4: Weekly allocation shown per person. Overallocation highlighted in red. Skill badges display top 3 skills. Team filter works. Grid scrollable horizontally for 12-week view.

column3: Build directed graph visualisation alongside Gantt. Nodes coloured by RAG status. Edges show dependency type. Critical path highlighted on milestone hover.
column4: Graph renders all project nodes and dependency edges. RAG colours applied to nodes. Critical path highlights in distinct colour on hover. Zoom and pan functional.

column3: Build configurable external-facing page at /ops/projects/[id]/status. Auto-populated from project data. PM adds optional commentary. Shareable link with optional password. Mobile-friendly.
column4: Page renders without authentication. PM can toggle which sections are visible. Commentary field saves. Shareable link generated. Optional password protection works.

column3: Build gate review interface within project workspace. Entry/exit criteria checklist. Approve/Fail/Waive action buttons. Required approvers list with status badges. Gate history.
column4: Criteria checklist interactive. Approve/Fail buttons trigger BE-13 workflow. Waive button visible to Admin only. Approver list shows who has/hasn't acted. Gate history shows all past outcomes.

column3: Build sprint-over-sprint throughput charts, cycle time scatter plot, and cumulative flow diagram (CFD). All charts filterable by date range.
column4: Throughput bar chart renders with trend line. Cycle time scatter plot highlights outliers (>2x median). CFD shows column distribution over time. Date range filter works.

column3: Build value vs effort 2x2 matrix view. Projects plotted as bubbles sized by budget. Score calculation using configurable weight coefficients (value, strategic fit, risk, effort).
column4: 2x2 matrix renders with project bubbles. Bubble size proportional to budget. Score formula uses configurable weights. PMO Admin can edit weight coefficients. Quadrant labels shown.

column3: Implement NestJS guards: AdminGuard, PMOGuard, ProjectManagerGuard, MemberGuard, StakeholderGuard. Apply to all endpoints per RBAC matrix §2.2.3.
column4: All unauthorised requests return 403. Guards tested for all four roles against every endpoint in §4.3. No elevation of privilege possible.
column12: RBAC matrix in §2.2.3 is the authoritative reference. Must be signed off before implementation.

column4: No DELETE/PUT endpoints exposed for AuditLog. API returns 405 Method Not Allowed. Verified in QA-06 security pen test.

column4: Code coverage >80% for RAG engine. All edge cases in §2.1.3 have explicit test cases. Priority order (RED > AMBER > GREEN) verified.

column3: Write Jest tests for all state transitions in the 5-state machine including backward transitions and blocker validation.
column4: All valid transitions have passing tests. All invalid transitions have rejection tests. Backward transition conditions verified. Blocker check for DONE verified.

column4: Both flows pass consistently in CI. All endpoints return expected status codes. RAG transitions verified against database state. Alert delivery verified.

column3: Test all four roles (Admin, PM, Member, Stakeholder) against all endpoints in §4.3. Verify 403/404 responses for unauthorised access patterns.
column4: All four roles tested against all endpoints. No role can access a resource it should not. No role is blocked from a resource it should have. Verified in CI.

column4: Script passes consistently in Staging. Invalid transition correctly blocked with user-facing error. DB state verified after each move. Blocker validation confirmed.

column4: All three Gantt signals render correctly in Playwright. RAID flag appears at correct date position. Overdue milestone diamond pulse verified. Tooltip content verified.

column4: All five attack vectors rejected. System returns appropriate error codes. No data leakage in error messages. All attempts logged to audit trail.
